about: The skills of the Vagabond (web/lib/skills.js, web/systems/skills.js). A skill point opens a skill (level 1) or raises it, up to maxLevel; each level after the first gives perLevel more damage. key: the key that starts it; needs: what the human must hold (sword: a sword in the weapon slot, shield: a shield); mp: its cost; cooldown: seconds before it can start again. steps: the hits of a combo, one press each (window: seconds to press again after a step; the cooldown starts when the combo ends). A step: clip (a state of character.json clips), rate (how much faster it plays), hits (seconds of the clip when a blow lands), power (times the damage of a hit), rush (seconds of the clip when the human rushes: behind its target, or distance forward), range, arc (degrees in front), around (every monster within range), stun (seconds the monster cannot move or hit). target: it needs a monster under the mouse, within range. needs nothing: bare hands are fine. blast: a ki blast made of cubes (web/systems/blasts.js): kind ball (it flies forward and bursts on the first monster, hurting every monster within blow) or beam (it goes forward and stays, hurting every monster on its way once, and digs a trench: dig); charge [from, to]: seconds of the clip when a ball grows in the hands (at hand: [right, up, forward] from the feet of the human); fire: when it leaves (from: where, else hand); end: when a beam stops; radius, speed, range, drop (it goes down this much at its far end: a ball then hits the ground); colors: its core, its middle and its edge; hole: the name of a hole of holes that it digs (a ball where it bursts, a beam all along its way from digFrom). holes: the shapes of holes, to swap in one word: width (the radius of the hole), deep (cubes deep in its middle).

transform.about: The transformation (web/lib/form.js, web/systems/transform.js), like Super Saiyan in Dragon Ball: open at level `level`, the key starts it when the human has `mp` MP. It plays the clip `powerup` of character.json (`rate` times its speed) while a gold aura grows and its hair (web/lib/superHair.js, a free VRoid hair) shakes, lifts and flickers gold; `burst` seconds into the clip (when the arms open) comes a flash: its hair stands up in gold spikes (in `flicker` seconds it settles), and the clip plays on to its end. Transformed, it hits `power` times harder, walks and runs `speed` times faster, and loses `drain` MP a second; the key again, no MP left, or death ends it, and it can start again `cooldown` seconds later.
